proof:
classical
have he (n : ℕ) : ev y v n = ((n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (y ^ n) v := rfl
have hz0 : (y ^ (l.toNat + 1)) v = 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := h_T003
  have he (n : ℕ) : ev y v n = ((n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (y ^ n) v := rfl
  have hb (i : Ix l) : h (B i) = ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • B i := by
    rw [hB i, he, map_smul, h_T001.2.2.2.2.1]
    simp only [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hc (w : V) (i : Ix l) :
      B.repr (h w) i = ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * B.repr w i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← B.sum_repr w]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, hb, smul_smul, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
      Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, B.repr_self_apply]
    simp [mul_comm]
  let z := (y ^ (l.toNat + 1)) v
  have hz : h z = ((l - 2 * ((l.toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • z :=
    h_T001.2.2.2.2.1 _
  apply B.repr.injective
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro i
  have hh := congrArg (fun w : V => B.repr w i) hz
  rw [hc] at hh
  simp only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hh
  have hd : (((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) -
      ((l - 2 * ((l.toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hi := (h_T001.2.1 i).2
    have hn := h_T001.1
    have hzint : (l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ)) - (l - 2 * ((l.toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
      push_cast
      omega
    exact_mod_cast hzint
  have hc0 : B.repr z i = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp (show (_ : ℂ) * B.repr z i = 0 by linear_combination hh)).resolve_left hd
  simpa only [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] using hc0
have htail (k : ℕ) : (y ^ ((l.toNat + 1) + k)) v = 0 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hz0
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.add_succ, pow_succ']
    change y ((y ^ ((l.toNat + 1) + k)) v) = 0
    rw [ih, map_zero]
have hvan (t : ℕ) (ht : l.toNat + 1 ≤ t) : (y ^ t) v = 0 := by
  have ht' : t = (l.toNat + 1) + (t - (l.toNat + 1)) := by omega
  rw [ht']
  exact htail _
have hx : ∀ n : ℕ, x (ev y v (n + 1)) =
    ((l - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) • ev y v n := by
  intro n
  have he (m : ℕ) : ev y v m = ((m.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (y ^ m) v := rfl
  rw [he, map_smul, h_T001.2.2.2.2.2 (n+1) (by omega), he]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
  push_cast
  have hn : (n : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hf : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  field_simp
  <;> ring
have hy : ∀ n : ℕ, y (ev y v n) = ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • ev y v (n+1) := by
  intro n
  have he (m : ℕ) : ev y v m = ((m.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (y ^ m) v := rfl
  rw [he, map_smul, he, pow_succ']
  change ((n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • y ((y ^ n) v) =
    ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • (((n+1).factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • y ((y ^ n) v)
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
  have hn : ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  field_simp
refine ⟨hvan, ?_⟩
unfold genFormulas
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro i
  rcases i with ⟨n, hn⟩
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa [ev, divided] using h_H004.2.1
  | succ n =>
    dsimp only [Fin.val_mk]
    rw [dif_pos (by omega)]
    simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hx n
· intro i
  by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < l.toNat + 1
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    exact hy i.val
  · rw [dif_neg hi, hy, he, hvan _ (by omega), smul_zero, smul_zero]
· intro i
  change h (ev y v i.val) = ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ev y v i.val
  rw [he, map_smul, h_T001.2.2.2.2.1]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring
